blocks.text: TikTok Korea has permanently removed the account of a former K-pop singer convicted of sex crimes against minors, just one day after he joined the platform. The Korean unit of TikTok said Monday that it permanently suspended and removed the account of Go Young-wook, a former member of the coed group Roo’ra, after becoming aware of it Sunday.
